records.subject: Labour, Employment, Wages and Productivity
records.title: Unemployment Rate (End Of Period), Quarterly, Seasonally Adjusted
records.footnote: Total population comprises residents and non residents.  Residents refer to Singapore citizens and permanent residents.  Data for June 1995, 2000 and 2005 were obtained from the General Household Survey (June 1995 and 2005) and Population Census (June 2000) conducted by the Singapore Department of Statistics, Ministry of Trade and Industry.  The Labour Force Survey was not conducted in these periods.

row.footnote: The seasonally adjusted figures are derived using X-12 ARIMA to remove the seasonal influences in the data series.  The seasonally adjusted unemployment figures are subject to annual revisions when the latest set of seasonal factors is updated, taking into account observations for the latest available year.
